<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1104
Claimant:
Shirley Rhodes
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
2024-01-04
First notice of loss received for a side impact at an intersection involving the insured's vehicle and a second car, with
the claimant reporting a knee injury and retaining counsel before the file was opened.
2024-01-10
Confirmed that the driver listed as the insured is named on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time
reported.
2024-01-18
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the scene, though no independent witness
statements or photographs of the collision have been located to date.
2024-02-20
Reviewed the vehicle damage estimate; the crush pattern and point of contact are consistent with the impact
described in the first notice.
2024-03-18
Claimant's account was taken by phone and repeated again in a second conversation with counsel present, with the
sequence of events matching in each telling.
2024-04-06
Medical records show a knee injury whose type and severity fit the force expected from a side impact of this kind, and
no prior treatment to that body area has turned up in the records requested.
2024-04-13
Noted a few old scratches on the vehicle that may predate this collision; the photos will be reviewed to separate them
from new damage.
2024-06-23
Treatment has continued for somewhat longer than is typical for this type of knee injury, and the treating provider's
notes have been requested to understand the reasons for the extended course.
2024-07-08
Checked policy history and found nothing indicating the damage occurred before coverage began; the effective dates
remain consistent with the loss.
2024-07-11
Counsel has been asked for the claimant's full treatment list and any additional documents supporting the injury
claim; the file remains open pending receipt.
2024-07-28
Reviewed the file summary with the supervisor, who agreed that the outstanding items are the provider notes, the full
scratch photo set, and independent confirmation of the collision if any becomes available.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
